strategy.summary: Collect two Triple Knights Challenge locks, start a Battle, then light and collect the third lock during the Battle and use POWER to simplify and double it.

steps.text: Hit the Light Lock target beside the Shield, then shoot the saucer behind the raised Shield to lock a ball. Repeat the target-and-saucer pair once, then leave the third lock unlit.
modeNotes: The third collected lock starts Triple Knights Challenge, so collect only two before the Battle.

steps.text: Make the required lit center progress shots until the center ramp is lit. Shoot that ramp to raise the Shield, then shoot the saucer to start the Battle.
modeNotes: Use this route while the third Triple Knights lock is still unlit.

steps.text: Build the Sword meter with the right drop targets and switch hits. When the center POWER target lights, leave it ready for the stack.
modeNotes: POWER makes the running Battle easier and doubles its scoring.

steps.text: After the Battle starts, hit Light Lock and shoot the Shield saucer for the third lock.
modeNotes: The third lock starts Triple Knights Challenge while the running Battle continues.

steps.text: During ball save, hit the lit POWER target. Complete the safer Battle shots first, then collect the multiball jackpots and its ramp hurry-up sequence.
modeNotes: Use the display's lit shots and counts; later qualifications require more progress.

fallback.title: Preserve battle progress
fallback.when: Use this plan when the center shots do not return safely.

steps.text: Use the left or right orbit to regain control; backhand the other shots when possible.
Start Triple Knights Challenge without a full Sword when a modest score is enough.
Hit the right-side targets to keep Magna-Save ready.

alternatives.title: WAR comeback
alternatives.when: Use this plan when you need a faster score and the center shots are working.

steps.text: Shoot the three lit center hurry-ups, then shoot the center target to complete the round.
Repeat W-A-R as its values rise.

alternatives.title: Mode-first KNIGHT Multiball
alternatives.when: Use this plan when the battle shots are repeatable but the Light Lock target and Shield locks return dangerously.

steps.text: Make the required center-shot hits to qualify Wicked Cavern, shoot the center ramp, then shoot the Shield saucer to start it. Alternate its lit left-side and right-side shots.
modeNotes: Wicked Cavern: Three successful shots award a K-N-I-G-H-T letter. Eight complete the battle.

steps.text: When SUPER lights at the center target, start the Super Mode. Boost it at the left lane only while that return stays controlled.
modeNotes: Super Mode: Right-spinner progress lights one untimed scoring feature at the center target. The left lane raises the value of every active Super Mode.

steps.text: Finish the battle. Use later battle letters or a completed WAR hurry-up to finish K-N-I-G-H-T. Do not start KNIGHT while a valuable timed battle is still running.
Shoot the left spinner lane for KNIGHT Multiball. Keep three balls alive, then use Magna-Save to cash the active Super Modes.
modeNotes: KNIGHT Multiball: Playfield scoring follows the number of active balls, up to 3x. Its multiplier can raise the Magna-Save Super Jackpot.

steps.text: Complete Battles to add K-N-I-G-H-T letters. Complete the word once to start classic KNIGHT Multiball.
Complete K-N-I-G-H-T a second time to qualify King's Ransom. Follow the lit start shown by the installed display.
Win all five Battles to qualify Black Castle and Rage Multiball. Follow the lit start shown by the installed display.

editionDifferences.pro: This upper-playfield multiball is not available.
editionDifferences.premium: The upper Catapult can qualify and start Catapult Multiball, adding another feature to the stack.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Backhand the Shield saucer with the slowest shot that reaches it. Use the first ball save to test the return.

techniques.name: Dead bounce on a center return
techniques.instruction: Dead bounce a clean center return to the opposite flipper before choosing the next shot.

cautions.issue: The three center shots can return the ball very fast.
cautions.response: Use low-speed backhands and dead bounces. Use initial ball save for center progress.

cautions.issue: A pop-bumper exit can miss the side wall and drain.
cautions.response: Hold the flipper only when it deadens the feed.

cautions.issue: A ball can stop behind the Shield.
cautions.response: Wait for ball search. Call the tournament director if the ball stays there.

cautions.issue: The Light Lock target can feed the right outlane.
cautions.response: Use a glancing hit and keep Magna-Save ready.

strategy.overview: Black Knight: Sword of Rage lets a Battle continue into Triple Knights Challenge. Hit a center shot once (then one more per Battle played), shoot center ramp, then Shield saucer to start; hit Light Lock before each saucer lock and take the third during Battle. When POWER lights at center target, collect it for 2x Battle scoring and easier Battle rules.
strategy.simpleOverview: Black Knight: Sword of Rage builds Battles at center shots and Triple Knights Challenge at Light Lock and Shield saucer. Hit a center shot once (then one more per Battle played), shoot center ramp, then saucer to start. Hit Light Lock before each saucer lock; take the third during Battle, then collect POWER at center target when lit.
